messages: sam: FYI linkcheck is failing in prod after the CDN switch. A bunch of image links return 301/302 and LinkCheck flags them as redirects. doc-bot: [linkcheck] ⚠️ 12 redirects found. Example: /guides/setup -> /guides/setup/assets/logo.png -> https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/logo.png (301) rebecca: Looks similar to the other CDN issue but different symptom: I think mkdocs is generating relative asset refs when pages are nested, and our CDN expects absolute /assets paths. jiho: Can you paste an example HTML snippet? sam: Sure — generated file /site/guides/setup/index.html contains `` so browser requests /guides/assets/logo.png which our redirect maps -> /assets/logo.png -> but because of the directory URL it sometimes redirects back to /guides/assets -> loop for some clients. alex: Quick mitigation I pushed to the CI build to rewrite asset refs to root paths so linkcheck passes. Patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/701 rebecca: What's in the patch? alex: Minimal sed replace in pipeline + nginx normalize rule. Diff:```bash # convert ../assets/... -> /assets/... find site -type f -name '*.html' -exec sed -i "s/src=\"\.+\/assets\//src=\"\/assets\//g" {} + ``` jiho: The sed looks fine as a bandaid but I don't love modifying generated HTML. We should fix the template/theme and config: set use_directory_urls: false or ensure assets are referenced with absolute paths in theme/templates. sam: Created ticket DOCS-319 to track the long-term fix. doc-bot: [deploy] ⛔ Build failed (linkcheck) — job: https://ci.redwood.ai/teams/docs/1256 alex: Also added nginx rule to collapse any /guides/*/assets/* -> /assets/* to avoid redirects looping: ```nginx location ~* ^/[^/]+/assets/(.*)$ { return 301 /assets/$1; } ``` rebecca: After applying the nginx rule on staging, linkcheck re-run -> zero redirect failures. Staging build: https://ci.redwood.ai/teams/docs/1260 ✅ jiho: Will follow up with a PR to the theme to render assets with absolute root paths and add tests for nested guides. I can take that on next week. sam: Thanks all. Merging the CI bandaid so the deploy can proceed. We'll keep DOCS-319 open for theme + config fix. :lock:
